meta.name: github-actions-templates
meta.description: Create production-ready GitHub Actions workflows for automated testing, building, and deploying applications. Use when setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, automating development workflows, or creating reusable workflow templates.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 装上它,你就能让代码自动跑测试、构建并发布,不用手写流水线配置。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果每次改完代码都要手动跑测试、构建和上线。
copy.tagline_en: Wire up automated test, build, and deploy pipelines without hand-writing config.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you push code often and want tests and deploys to run automatically.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会生成可直接使用的 GitHub Actions 工作流 YAML,覆盖测试、构建并推送 Docker 镜像、部署 Kubernetes、矩阵构建、安全扫描、带审批的生产部署等场景,也能给出可复用工作流的写法。
howto.when: 当你要用 GitHub Actions 搭建 CI/CD、自动化开发流程,或创建可复用工作流模板时会用到它。

say.text: 帮我写一个在 push 和 PR 时跑 npm 测试的 workflow
say.note: 产出含 Node 矩阵版本与覆盖率上传的工作流

say.text: 给我一个构建 Docker 镜像并推送到 ghcr.io 的工作流
say.note: 含登录、元数据提取与缓存配置

say.text: 写一个部署到 Kubernetes 并用 Slack 通知的工作流
say.note: 含 kubeconfig 更新与部署校验步骤

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude generates ready-to-use GitHub Actions workflow YAML for CI/CD: testing, building and pushing Docker images, Kubernetes deploys, matrix builds, security scans, and approval-gated releases.
howto.when_en: Use it when setting up CI/CD with GitHub Actions, automating development workflows, or creating reusable workflow templates.

say_en.text: Write a workflow that runs npm tests on push and PR
say_en.note: Returns a test workflow with a Node matrix and coverage upload

say_en.text: Give me a workflow that builds a Docker image and pushes to ghcr.io
say_en.note: Includes login, metadata extraction, and caching

say_en.text: Write a workflow that deploys to Kubernetes and notifies Slack
say_en.note: Includes kubeconfig update and rollout verification
